-Workspace grouping has a Separate Groups and Workspaces toggle in the Sessions view's overflow menu, and in the phone's sort and group sheet, shown while workspaces (`sessions.workspaces.enabled`) and AI features are enabled. The choice is profile-local, and every open Sessions view of the profile follows it as it changes; it is off by default; it applies only while workspaces are enabled, and off, workspace grouping lists as described above. A stored choice of the former Workspaces & Groups grouping opens as workspace grouping with the toggle on, also while workspaces are off; otherwise a choice to turn it off stays. The list's agent tool reads and sets it as `separateGroupsAndWorkspaces`, and takes the former grouping's value as workspace grouping with it on. With the toggle on, below Pinned and Chats, a Groups section holds the top-level custom groups, in their user-managed order, and a Workspaces section holds the workspaces, by name; External and archived follow as in other groupings. A session lists under the workspace of its `.code-workspace` file, else under its default folder, also when the file was renamed since. The workspaces service provides a row's name, icon and color; a folder it does not know shows the folder's name, and sessions without a folder list under Unknown, last. The Agents window's own workspaces list even without sessions, saying so, unless a search or scope narrows the list. Both parent sections and every row keep their collapse state. The top-level headers are muted labels with their twistie after the label, shown while hovered, focused or collapsed, and a gap above each but the first; Chats, Groups and Workspaces show no icon, while the group and workspace rows show theirs. A pinned group or workspace row shows only under Pinned and returns to its place when unpinned.

+Workspace grouping has a Separate Groups and Workspaces toggle in the Sessions view's overflow menu, and in the phone's sort and group sheet, shown while workspaces (`sessions.workspaces.enabled`, Insiders only: Stable neither registers the setting nor honors it when written by hand) and AI features are enabled. The choice is profile-local, and every open Sessions view of the profile follows it as it changes; it is off by default; it applies only while workspaces are enabled, and off, workspace grouping lists as described above. A stored choice of the former Workspaces & Groups grouping opens as workspace grouping with the toggle on, also while workspaces are off; otherwise a choice to turn it off stays. The list's agent tool reads and sets it as `separateGroupsAndWorkspaces`, and takes the former grouping's value as workspace grouping with it on. With the toggle on, below Pinned and Chats, a Groups section holds the top-level custom groups, in their user-managed order, and a Workspaces section holds the workspaces, by name; External and archived follow as in other groupings. A session lists under the workspace of its `.code-workspace` file, else under its default folder, also when the file was renamed since. The workspaces service provides a row's name, icon and color; a folder it does not know shows the folder's name, and sessions without a folder list under Unknown, last. The Agents window's own workspaces list even without sessions, saying so, unless a search or scope narrows the list. Both parent sections and every row keep their collapse state. The top-level headers are muted labels with their twistie after the label, shown while hovered, focused or collapsed, and a gap above each but the first; Chats, Groups and Workspaces show no icon, while the group and workspace rows show theirs. A pinned group or workspace row shows only under Pinned and returns to its place when unpinned.
